q: 朋友的家在河对面，我们明天走过___找他。
zh: 朋友的家在河对面，我们明天走过去找他。
py: péng you de jiā zài hé duì miàn wǒ men míng tiān zǒu guò qù zhǎo tā
en: My friend's home is across the river, and we will walk over to see him tomorrow.
why: We are on this bank and the home is on the far side, away from the speaker, so 过去. 过来 would need the friend to be on our side.

q: 我正在屋里看电视，朋友走___了。
zh: 我正在屋里看电视，朋友走进屋来了。
py: wǒ zhèng zài wū lǐ kàn diàn shì péng you zǒu jìn wū lái le
en: I was watching TV in the room when my friend walked in.
why: The place 屋 splits 进 and 来: 进屋来. Putting 屋 after 来 (进来屋) is the classic error.

s: 这条路看出来很远，其实不远。
s_py: zhè tiáo lù kàn chū lái hěn yuǎn qí shí bù yuǎn
zh: 这条路看起来很远，其实不远。
py: zhè tiáo lù kàn qǐ lái hěn yuǎn qí shí bù yuǎn
en: This road looks far, but it really isn't.
why: An impression is 看起来 + comment. 看出来 means you work something out, and cannot be followed by 很远 in this way.

s: 雨下了一整天，大家只好留下来在家里聊天。
s_py: yǔ xià le yī zhěng tiān dà jiā zhǐ hǎo liú xià lái zài jiā lǐ liáo tiān
zh: 雨下了一整天，大家只好留下来在家里聊天。
py: yǔ xià le yī zhěng tiān dà jiā zhǐ hǎo liú xià lái zài jiā lǐ liáo tiān
en: It rained all day, so everyone had to stay in and chat at home.
why: Staying on is 留下来. 下去 would be wrong here because the group is staying put, not continuing something.

s: 她看起来很高兴，好像有什么好事。
s_py: tā kàn qǐ lái hěn gāo xìng hǎo xiàng yǒu shén me hǎo shì
zh: 她看起来很高兴，好像有什么好事。
py: tā kàn qǐ lái hěn gāo xìng hǎo xiàng yǒu shén me hǎo shì
en: She looks happy, as if something good has happened.
why: An impression is 看起来 + comment, which is correct here.

q: 朋友换了新发型，我差点儿没认___。
zh: 朋友换了新发型，我差点儿没认出来。
py: péng you huàn le xīn fà xíng wǒ chà diǎn r méi rèn chū lái
en: My friend had a new hairstyle and I almost didn't recognise her.
why: Recognising a person is 认出来, with 没 before it for failing. 认起来 and 认下来 are not used.

s: 朋友从国外给我寄来了一份礼物。
s_py: péng you cóng guó wài gěi wǒ jì lái le yī fèn lǐ wù
zh: 朋友从国外给我寄来了一份礼物。
py: péng you cóng guó wài gěi wǒ jì lái le yī fèn lǐ wù
en: A friend sent me a gift from abroad.
why: The gift travels toward the speaker, so 寄来 is right, and 了 can follow it with the object after.

q: 春天来了，天气慢慢暖和___了。
zh: 春天来了，天气慢慢暖和起来了。
py: chūn tiān lái le tiān qì màn màn nuǎn huo qǐ lái le
en: Spring has come and the weather is slowly getting warm.
why: An adjective that grows, like getting warm, takes 起来 to show the change starting. 下来 is for things that settle or fall.

q: 我在屋里看电视，下雨了，小狗从院子里跑___来了。
zh: 我在屋里看电视，下雨了，小狗从院子里跑进来了。
py: wǒ zài wū lǐ kàn diàn shì xià yǔ le xiǎo gǒu cóng yuàn zi lǐ pǎo jìn lái le
en: I was watching TV indoors when it rained, and the dog ran in from the yard.
why: The speaker is indoors and the dog moves from the yard into the house: 跑进来. 跑出来 would need the speaker to be outside the yard.

q: 为了不忘记朋友们说的好办法，我拿出笔记本，把大家的建议一条一条记___。
zh: 为了不忘记朋友们说的好办法，我拿出笔记本，把大家的建议一条一条记下来。
py: wèi le bù wàng jì péng you men shuō de hǎo bàn fǎ wǒ ná chū bǐ jì běn bǎ dà jiā de jiàn yì yī tiáo yī tiáo jì xià lái
en: So as not to forget my friends' good ideas, I took out a notebook and noted down everyone's suggestions one by one.
why: Getting something fixed in a notebook is 记下来. 记下去 would mean carrying on recording, and 记出来 is not used.

q: 她从小就喜欢画画，今年终于考___了美术学院。
zh: 她从小就喜欢画画，今年终于考上了美术学院。
py: tā cóng xiǎo jiù xǐ huan huà huà jīn nián zhōng yú kǎo shàng le měi shù xué yuàn
en: She has loved painting since she was little, and this year she finally got into the art academy.
why: Reaching a goal such as entry to a school is verb + 上: 考上. 考出 and 考下 do not mean passing into a school.

q: 雨下得太大了，我们先在咖啡馆里停___，等雨小一点再走。
zh: 雨下得太大了，我们先在咖啡馆里停下来，等雨小一点再走。
py: yǔ xià de tài dà le wǒ men xiān zài kā fēi guǎn lǐ tíng xià lái děng yǔ xiǎo yī diǎn zài zǒu
en: The rain is too heavy, so let's stop in the cafe for now and leave when it eases.
why: Coming to a stop is 停下来. 停下去 would not mean stopping, and 停起来 is not used.

q: 我在屋里，下雨了，你快把阳台上的衣服收___！
zh: 我在屋里，下雨了，你快把阳台上的衣服收进来！
py: wǒ zài wū lǐ xià yǔ le nǐ kuài bǎ yáng tái shàng de yī fu shōu jìn lái
en: I'm indoors and it's raining, quickly bring the clothes on the balcony in!
why: The clothes move into the room where the speaker is: 收进来. 收进去 would suit a speaker who is outside, and 来进 reverses the parts.

src_py: péng you zǒu jìn lái le
task: Add 教室 (classroom) to the sentence.
zh: 朋友走进教室来了。
py: péng you zǒu jìn jiào shì lái le
en: My friend walked into the classroom.
why: The place goes between 走进 and 来. 走进来教室 would put the place after 来.

s: 天冷了，你把外套穿起吧。
s_py: tiān lěng le nǐ bǎ wài tào chuān qǐ ba
zh: 天冷了，你把外套穿上吧。
py: tiān lěng le nǐ bǎ wài tào chuān shàng ba
en: It's cold, put your coat on.
why: Putting something on is verb + 上: 穿上. 穿起 alone is not a complete phrase.

zh: 小李跑回宿舍去了。
py: xiǎo lǐ pǎo huí sù shè qù le
en: Xiao Li ran back to the dorm.
why: The place 宿舍 sits between 跑回 and 去, and 去 closes the phrase. 去 cannot come before 宿舍.

src_py: yè lǐ jiē shàng hěn ān jìng
task: Say the street gradually became quiet.
zh: 街上慢慢安静下来了。
py: jiē shàng màn màn ān jìng xià lái le
en: The street slowly became quiet.
why: Growing quiet is settling, so 安静下来. 慢慢 goes before the adjective.

s: 他从包里拿来出一本书。
s_py: tā cóng bāo lǐ ná lái chū yī běn shū
zh: 他从包里拿出来一本书。
py: tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū lái yī běn shū
en: He took a book out of his bag.
why: The direction word comes before 来: 拿出来. 拿来出 reverses the two parts.

q: 我们站在山脚下，小李已经爬到山顶了，他喊我们：“快上___！”
zh: 我们站在山脚下，小李已经爬到山顶了，他喊我们：“快上来！”
py: wǒ men zhàn zài shān jiǎo xià xiǎo lǐ yǐ jīng pá dào shān dǐng le tā hǎn wǒ men kuài shàng lái
en: We were at the foot of the mountain. Xiao Li had already reached the top and called out, 'Come up quickly!'
why: The speaker, 小李, is at the top, so climbing toward him is 上来. 上去 is for a speaker who stays at the bottom and sends someone up.

s: 我在三楼，你快上去吧，朋友们都在这儿等你。
s_py: wǒ zài sān lóu nǐ kuài shàng qù ba péng you men dōu zài zhè ér děng nǐ
zh: 我在三楼，你快上来吧，朋友们都在这儿等你。
py: wǒ zài sān lóu nǐ kuài shàng lái ba péng you men dōu zài zhè ér děng nǐ
en: I'm on the third floor, come up quickly, our friends are all waiting for you here.
why: The speaker is on the third floor, so the movement is toward the speaker: 上来. 上去 would mean the speaker stays downstairs.

q: 天黑了，朋友们都想回家，只有小李愿意留___陪我。
zh: 天黑了，朋友们都想回家，只有小李愿意留下来陪我。
py: tiān hēi le péng you men dōu xiǎng huí jiā zhǐ yǒu xiǎo lǐ yuàn yì liú xià lái péi wǒ
en: It was dark and my friends all wanted to go home. Only Xiao Li was willing to stay on with me.
why: Staying behind is 留下来. 留下去 and 留起来 do not express staying.

q: 我把心里的想法都说___了，现在觉得轻松多了。
zh: 我把心里的想法都说出来了，现在觉得轻松多了。
py: wǒ bǎ xīn lǐ de xiǎng fǎ dōu shuō chū lái le xiàn zài jué de qīng sōng duō le
en: I've said everything that was on my mind and now I feel much lighter.
why: Bringing a hidden thought into the open is 说出来. 说起来 means starting to talk, and 说下去 means carrying on.

zh: 我一眼就看出来你今天不高兴。
py: wǒ yī yǎn jiù kàn chū lái nǐ jīn tiān bù gāo xìng
en: I could tell at a glance that you're unhappy today.
why: 看出来 means to tell by looking. 出来 stays right behind 看 and the clause that says what is noticed follows it.

src: 她从包里拿出来一把伞。
src_py: tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū lái yī bǎ sǎn
zh: 她从包里拿出一把伞来。
py: tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yī bǎ sǎn lái
en: She took an umbrella out of her bag.
why: The object can go between 拿出 and 来. Splitting the complement this way keeps 来 at the end of the phrase.

src_py: tā men yī jiàn miàn jiù liáo tiān
task: Say they start chatting (use 起来).
zh: 他们一见面就聊起天来。
py: tā men yī jiàn miàn jiù liáo qǐ tiān lái
en: They start chatting the moment they meet.
why: 聊天 has an object inside it, so 起来 wraps around it: 聊起天来. 聊天起来 is wrong.

zh: 同学们都跑出教室去了。
py: tóng xué men dōu pǎo chū jiào shì qù le
en: The students all ran out of the classroom.
why: The place 教室 goes between 跑出 and 去. 去 cannot follow before the place.

q: 虽然很累，但是这个读书会已经办了三年，往后我们也要继续坚持___。
zh: 虽然很累，但是这个读书会已经办了三年，往后我们也要继续坚持下去。
py: suī rán hěn lèi dàn shì zhè ge dú shū huì yǐ jīng bàn le sān nián wǎng hòu wǒ men yě yào jì xù jiān chí xià qù
en: We're tired, but this book club has already run for three years, and from now on we will keep it going.
why: From now on points forward, so 坚持下去. 坚持下来 looks back on having kept going until now.

q: 他从背包里拿___一把伞来，原来他早就知道会下雨。
zh: 他从背包里拿出一把伞来，原来他早就知道会下雨。
py: tā cóng bēi bāo lǐ ná chū yī bǎ sǎn lái yuán lái tā zǎo jiù zhī dào huì xià yǔ
en: He took an umbrella out of his backpack, so he had known it would rain all along.
why: 从背包里 shows the umbrella comes out of the bag: 拿出. 拿进 and 拿回 point the wrong way, and 拿下 means taking something down from a height.

q: 朋友在学校，我在家，我把雨伞给他送___了。
zh: 朋友在学校，我在家，我把雨伞给他送去了。
py: péng you zài xué xiào wǒ zài jiā wǒ bǎ yǔ sǎn gěi tā sòng qù le
en: My friend is at school and I'm at home, so I took the umbrella over to him.
why: The umbrella goes from home, where the speaker is, to school, which is away from the speaker: 送去. 送来 would mean it was brought to the speaker.

s: 他睡了很久才醒起来，朋友们已经走了。
s_py: tā shuì le hěn jiǔ cái xǐng qǐ lái péng you men yǐ jīng zǒu le
zh: 他睡了很久才醒过来，朋友们已经走了。
py: tā shuì le hěn jiǔ cái xǐng guò lái péng you men yǐ jīng zǒu le
en: He slept for a long time before waking up, and his friends had already gone.
why: Waking up is 醒过来. 醒起来 does not exist.

src_py: tiān lěng le wǒ chuān le wài tào
task: Use 上 to say you put the coat on.
zh: 天冷了我穿上了外套。
py: tiān lěng le wǒ chuān shàng le wài tào
en: It got cold, so I put on a coat.
why: 穿上 means put on. 了 can follow 上 or the object, so both orders work.

s: 我没把手机带出来，所以没法给你打电话。
s_py: wǒ méi bǎ shǒu jī dài chū lái suǒ yǐ méi fǎ gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
zh: 我没把手机带出来，所以没法给你打电话。
py: wǒ méi bǎ shǒu jī dài chū lái suǒ yǐ méi fǎ gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
en: I didn't bring my phone with me, so I can't call you.
why: 没 goes before 把, and 带出来 stays together after the object. This is the correct order.

s: 你把伞放进去包里吧。
s_py: nǐ bǎ sǎn fàng jìn qù bāo lǐ ba
zh: 你把伞放进包里去吧。
py: nǐ bǎ sǎn fàng jìn bāo lǐ qù ba
en: Put the umbrella in your bag.
why: The place 包里 must come before 去. 放进去包里 puts it after 去, which is never allowed.

zh: 我在楼下你快下来吧。
py: wǒ zài lóu xià nǐ kuài xià lái ba
en: I'm downstairs, come down quickly.
why: The speaker is downstairs, so the person coming down moves toward the speaker: 下来. The reason clause can also come second.

src_py: wǒ bǎ yǔ sǎn dài chū qù le
zh: 我没把雨伞带出去。
py: wǒ méi bǎ yǔ sǎn dài chū qù
en: I didn't take the umbrella with me.
why: Negative 没 goes before 把, and 了 is dropped because 没 already says it did not happen.

q: 我们刚到车站，朋友就从人群里向我们___了。
zh: 我们刚到车站，朋友就从人群里向我们走过来了。
py: wǒ men gāng dào chē zhàn péng you jiù cóng rén qún lǐ xiàng wǒ men zǒu guò lái le
en: As soon as we reached the station, our friend walked over to us from the crowd.
why: The order is action verb, then direction word, then 来: 走过来. 走来过 and 过来走 reverse the parts, and 走起来 means start walking, not walking toward us.

zh: 早上下起雪来了。
py: zǎo shàng xià qǐ xuě lái le
en: It started snowing this morning.
why: 下起雪来 puts the object 雪 between 起 and 来. 来 comes last, before 了.

zh: 雨停了请把伞带回去。
py: yǔ tíng le qǐng bǎ sǎn dài huí qù
en: The rain has stopped, please take the umbrella back with you.
why: 把 and its object go before the verb, and the verb keeps its complement 回去 right behind it. The object cannot follow 带回去.

q: 同学聚会那天，我们都在上海，小李从老家带___了一大包特产，大家都抢着尝。
zh: 同学聚会那天，我们都在上海，小李从老家带来了一大包特产，大家都抢着尝。
py: tóng xué jù huì nà tiān wǒ men dōu zài shàng hǎi xiǎo lǐ cóng lǎo jiā dài lái le yī dà bāo tè chǎn dà jiā dōu qiǎng zhe cháng
en: On the day of the class reunion we were all in Shanghai, and Xiao Li brought a big bag of local specialities from his hometown, and everyone rushed to taste them.
why: The reunion, and the speaker, are in Shanghai, so bringing the food there is 带来. 带去 would take it away from the speaker.

zh: 你把电话号码写下来吧。
py: nǐ bǎ diàn huà hào mǎ xiě xià lái ba
en: Write down your phone number.
why: 把 + object + verb + 下来 fixes the number on paper. 下来 stays with the verb and cannot come before 把.

q: 这道菜是妈妈照着朋友的食谱自己做___的，没想到味道跟饭馆的差不多。
zh: 这道菜是妈妈照着朋友的食谱自己做出来的，没想到味道跟饭馆的差不多。
py: zhè dào cài shì mā mā zhào zhe péng you de shí pǔ zì jǐ zuò chū lái de méi xiǎng dào wèi dào gēn fàn guǎn de chà bu duō
en: My mum made this dish herself following my friend's recipe, and surprisingly it tastes much like a restaurant's.
why: Producing a finished dish is 做出来. 做起来 would mean starting to cook or give an impression of how it is to cook.

q: 你不用说，我已经看___你今天不高兴了。
zh: 你不用说，我已经看出来你今天不高兴了。
py: nǐ bú yòng shuō wǒ yǐ jīng kàn chū lái nǐ jīn tiān bù gāo xìng le
en: You don't need to say anything, I can already see that you're unhappy today.
why: Noticing a hidden feeling by looking is 看出来. 看起来 gives an impression and cannot take 你 as an object here.

q: 你睡了两个小时才醒___，快起床吧，朋友们都在楼下等着呢。
zh: 你睡了两个小时才醒过来，快起床吧，朋友们都在楼下等着呢。
py: nǐ shuì le liǎng gè xiǎo shí cái xǐng guò lái kuài qǐ chuáng ba péng you men dōu zài lóu xià děng zhe ne
en: You slept for two hours before waking up. Get up, our friends are all waiting downstairs.
why: Coming back to consciousness is 醒过来. 醒过去 is the opposite direction, and 醒起来 does not exist.

q: 一说到暑假要去海边玩，大家都兴奋___，你一句我一句地讨论行程。
zh: 一说到暑假要去海边玩，大家都兴奋起来，你一句我一句地讨论行程。
py: yī shuō dào shǔ jià yào qù hǎi biān wán dà jiā dōu xīng fèn qǐ lái nǐ yī jù wǒ yī jù de tǎo lùn xíng chéng
en: As soon as the summer trip to the seaside came up, everyone got excited and began discussing the plan, each chiming in.
why: Getting excited is a feeling that starts and grows: 兴奋起来. 下来 would mean calming down, the reverse.

q: 他的名字我忘了，想了很久才想___，原来他叫小周。
zh: 他的名字我忘了，想了很久才想起来，原来他叫小周。
py: tā de míng zì wǒ wàng le xiǎng le hěn jiǔ cái xiǎng qǐ lái yuán lái tā jiào xiǎo zhōu
en: I'd forgotten his name, and only after thinking a long time did I remember: he's called Xiao Zhou.
why: Recalling a known name is 想起来. 想出来 is for thinking up something new, such as an idea.

zh: 这件毛衣穿起来很暖和。
py: zhè jiàn máo yī chuān qǐ lái hěn nuǎn huo
en: This sweater feels warm to wear.
why: 穿起来 + comment gives how something feels in use. The comment comes after 起来, not before.

q: 天要下雪了，我们把自行车___吧。
zh: 天要下雪了，我们把自行车推进屋里去吧。
py: tiān yào xià xuě le wǒ men bǎ zì xíng chē tuī jìn wū lǐ qù ba
en: It's about to snow, so let's push the bikes into the house.
why: The place 屋里 sits between 进 and 去: 推进屋里去. 推进去屋里 puts the place after 去, and the other options scramble the parts.

src_py: wǒ zhī dào shì xiǎo zhōu chàng de
task: Say you could tell by listening (use 听出来).
zh: 我听出来是小周唱的。
py: wǒ tīng chū lái shì xiǎo zhōu chàng de
en: I could tell it was Xiao Zhou singing.
why: 听出来 means working out who it is by hearing. 听起来 would describe an impression instead.

q: 雨一停，同学们就都___踢球了，我一个人留在宿舍里写作业。
zh: 雨一停，同学们就都跑出宿舍去踢球了，我一个人留在宿舍里写作业。
py: yǔ yī tíng tóng xué men jiù dōu pǎo chū sù shè qù tī qiú le wǒ yī gè rén liú zài sù shè lǐ xiě zuò yè
en: As soon as the rain stopped the classmates all ran out of the dorm to play football, while I stayed in the dorm doing homework.
why: 宿舍 is the place being left, so it goes between 出 and 去: 跑出宿舍去. 去 fits because the speaker stays in the dorm. 跑出去宿舍 puts the place after 去.

q: 你的声音很特别，我一听就听___是你。
zh: 你的声音很特别，我一听就听出来是你。
py: nǐ de shēng yīn hěn tè bié wǒ yī tīng jiù tīng chū lái shì nǐ
en: Your voice is distinctive. I could tell it was you the moment I heard it.
why: Working out who it is by listening is 听出来. 听起来 would give an impression instead.

zh: 他从包里拿出一把伞来。
py: tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yī bǎ sǎn lái
en: He took an umbrella out of his bag.
why: A thing object can come before 来 (拿出一把伞来) or after it (拿出来一把伞). Both orders are fine, but 拿出 stays with the verb.

q: 听到朋友敲门，我马上从沙发上站___来去开门。
zh: 听到朋友敲门，我马上从沙发上站起来去开门。
py: tīng dào péng you qiāo mén wǒ mǎ shàng cóng shā fā shàng zhàn qǐ lái qù kāi mén
en: Hearing my friend knock, I stood up from the sofa at once and went to open the door.
why: Rising from a seat is 站起来. 站上来 would mean climbing up onto something, and 站下来 means coming to a halt.

q: 雪停了，孩子们都从屋里跑___去玩雪了。
zh: 雪停了，孩子们都从屋里跑出去玩雪了。
py: xuě tíng le hái zi men dōu cóng wū lǐ pǎo chū qù wán xuě le
en: The snow stopped and the children all ran out of the house to play in it.
why: 从屋里 says the movement leaves the house, so the direction word is 出: 跑出去. 进 means into, and 起去 does not exist.

q: 这件毛衣穿___很暖和，冬天最合适。
zh: 这件毛衣穿起来很暖和，冬天最合适。
py: zhè jiàn máo yī chuān qǐ lái hěn nuǎn huo dōng tiān zuì hé shì
en: This sweater feels warm to wear, perfect for winter.
why: How something feels in use is verb + 起来 + comment: 穿起来很暖和. 穿出来 would mean coming out wearing it.

q: 他们俩吵了半天，后来雨声越来越大，两个人都慢慢平静___，谁也不说话了。
zh: 他们俩吵了半天，后来雨声越来越大，两个人都慢慢平静下来，谁也不说话了。
py: tā men liǎ chǎo le bàn tiān hòu lái yǔ shēng yuè lái yuè dà liǎng gè rén dōu màn màn píng jìng xià lái shuí yě bù shuō huà le
en: The two of them argued for a long while, then the rain grew louder, and both slowly calmed down and neither spoke.
why: Calming down is 平静下来. 平静起来 would mean starting to become calm, and 下去 would mean continuing to be calm.

q: 你的故事真有意思，请你说___。
zh: 你的故事真有意思，请你说下去。
py: nǐ de gù shì zhēn yǒu yì si qǐng nǐ shuō xià qù
en: Your story is really interesting, please go on.
why: Carrying on with something already under way is 说下去. 说起来 would mean starting to talk, and 说下来 does not fit.

zh: 他没把朋友送的那把伞带出去。
py: tā méi bǎ péng you sòng de nà bǎ sǎn dài chū qù
en: He didn't take the umbrella his friend gave him out with him.
why: 没 goes before 把, the specific object goes after 把, and the verb with 出去 stays together at the end.

zh: 孩子们唱起歌来了。
py: hái zi men chàng qǐ gē lái le
en: The children started singing.
why: With an object, 起来 splits around it: 唱起歌来. 歌 cannot go before 起来 or after 来.

s: 昨天夜里下雪起来了，早上路上全是白的。
s_py: zuó tiān yè lǐ xià xuě qǐ lái le zǎo shàng lù shàng quán shì bái de
zh: 昨天夜里下起雪来了，早上路上全是白的。
py: zuó tiān yè lǐ xià qǐ xuě lái le zǎo shàng lù shàng quán shì bái de
en: It started snowing last night, and in the morning the roads were all white.
why: With 起来 'start', the object goes between 起 and 来: 下起雪来. It cannot come before 起来.

q: 天气一直这么热，再这样___，大家都会生病的。
zh: 天气一直这么热，再这样下去，大家都会生病的。
py: tiān qì yī zhí zhè me rè zài zhè yàng xià qù dà jiā dōu huì shēng bìng de
en: The weather keeps being this hot. If it goes on like this, everyone will get ill.
why: 再这样下去 is the fixed phrase for 'if this continues'. 下来 looks back, and 起来 starts something.

q: 我在北京，小周在国外，他说明年想___工作。
zh: 我在北京，小周在国外，他说明年想回北京来工作。
py: wǒ zài běi jīng xiǎo zhōu zài guó wài tā shuō míng nián xiǎng huí běi jīng lái gōng zuò
en: I'm in Beijing and Xiao Zhou is abroad. He says he wants to come back to Beijing to work next year.
why: 北京 is the place, so it goes before 来: 回北京来. 来 fits because the speaker is in Beijing; 回来北京 puts the place after 来.

q: 雪下得太大，天又黑了，我们在路灯下几乎看不___对面是谁。
zh: 雪下得太大，天又黑了，我们在路灯下几乎看不出来对面是谁。
py: xuě xià de tài dà tiān yòu hēi le wǒ men zài lù dēng xià jī hū kàn bù chū lái duì miàn shì shuí
en: The snow was so heavy, and it was dark, so under the street lamp we could hardly make out who was on the other side.
why: Failing to tell who it is by looking is 看不出来. 看不起来 is not a phrase.

q: 天气太热，我一进屋就在沙发上坐___来，不想再动了。
zh: 天气太热，我一进屋就在沙发上坐下来，不想再动了。
py: tiān qì tài rè wǒ yī jìn wū jiù zài shā fā shàng zuò xià lái bù xiǎng zài dòng le
en: It was so hot that as soon as I came in I sat down on the sofa and did not want to move again.
why: Settling into a seat is 坐下来. 坐起来 means sitting up from lying down, which does not fit someone who has just walked in.

q: 下雨了，我们快跑___吧。
zh: 下雨了，我们快跑回家去吧。
py: xià yǔ le wǒ men kuài pǎo huí jiā qù ba
en: It's raining, let's run home quickly.
why: A place goes between the direction word and 去: 回家去. 回去家 puts 家 after 去, which Chinese never does.

s: 不管多难，我都会学下去汉语。
s_py: bù guǎn duō nán wǒ dōu huì xué xià qù hàn yǔ
zh: 不管多难，我都会把汉语学下去。
py: bù guǎn duō nán wǒ dōu huì bǎ hàn yǔ xué xià qù
en: However hard it is, I will keep studying Chinese.
why: 下去 takes no object after it. Move 汉语 in front of the verb with 把: 把汉语学下去.

q: 春天到了，他们俩在一次聚会上认识了，后来他慢慢爱___了她。
zh: 春天到了，他们俩在一次聚会上认识了，后来他慢慢爱上了她。
py: chūn tiān dào le tā men liǎ zài yī cì jù huì shàng rèn shí le hòu lái tā màn màn ài shàng le tā
en: Spring came, they met at a party, and later he slowly fell in love with her.
why: A new state beginning is 爱上: he came to love her. 爱起 and 爱下 are not used this way.

q: 朋友进门以后，顺手把门关___了。
zh: 朋友进门以后，顺手把门关上了。
py: péng you jìn mén yǐ hòu shùn shǒu bǎ mén guān shàng le
en: After my friend came in, he closed the door behind him.
why: Closing is verb + 上, with no 来/去: 关上. 关来 and 关出 are not words.

s: 我在楼下，你快下来吧，朋友们都在等你。
s_py: wǒ zài lóu xià nǐ kuài xià lái ba péng you men dōu zài děng nǐ
zh: 我在楼下，你快下来吧，朋友们都在等你。
py: wǒ zài lóu xià nǐ kuài xià lái ba péng you men dōu zài děng nǐ
en: I'm downstairs, come down quickly, our friends are all waiting for you.
why: The speaker is downstairs, so a person coming down moves toward the speaker: 下来 is correct.

zh: 小狗从院子里跑出来了。
py: xiǎo gǒu cóng yuàn zi lǐ pǎo chū lái le
en: The dog ran out of the yard.
why: From where, then the verb, then direction and 来: 从院子里跑出来. 出来 stays together after the verb.

q: 这家餐厅的菜___很普通，___却特别香。
zh: 这家餐厅的菜看起来很普通，吃起来却特别香。
py: zhè jiā cān tīng de cài kàn qǐ lái hěn pǔ tōng chī qǐ lái què tè bié xiāng
en: The dishes at this restaurant look very ordinary, but they taste especially good.
why: Impressions use verb + 起来: 看起来 and 吃起来. 看出来 means working something out by looking, which does not fit 'look ordinary'.

src_py: wǒ guān shàng le nà shàn chuāng hu
zh: 我把那扇窗户关上了。
py: wǒ bǎ nà shàn chuāng hu guān shàng le
en: I closed that window.
why: 把 moves the specific object in front of the verb, and the verb keeps its complement 上 and 了.

q: 秋天到了，周末我们一起___看红叶吧。
zh: 秋天到了，周末我们一起上山去看红叶吧。
py: qiū tiān dào le zhōu mò wǒ men yī qǐ shàng shān qù kàn hóng yè ba
en: Autumn is here, so let's go up the mountain together this weekend to see the red leaves.
why: 山 is a place, so it must sit between 上 and 去: 上山去. 上去山 puts it after 去.

q: 朋友们都在我家，小周也从超市买___了一大袋零食。
zh: 朋友们都在我家，小周也从超市买来了一大袋零食。
py: péng you men dōu zài wǒ jiā xiǎo zhōu yě cóng chāo shì mǎi lái le yī dà dài líng shí
en: My friends were all at my place, and Xiao Zhou also bought a big bag of snacks at the supermarket and brought it over.
why: The snacks end up where the speaker is, so 买来了. 买去 would send them away from the speaker; 出 and 进 need a place to leave or enter.

s: 他睡了一下午才醒过来。
s_py: tā shuì le yī xià wǔ cái xǐng guò lái
zh: 他睡了一下午才醒过来。
py: tā shuì le yī xià wǔ cái xǐng guò lái
en: He slept all afternoon before waking up.
why: Waking up from sleep is 醒过来, which is the correct form here.

q: 明天的聚会别忘了，最好现在就把时间记___，免得又忘了。
zh: 明天的聚会别忘了，最好现在就把时间记下来，免得又忘了。
py: míng tiān de jù huì bié wàng le zuì hǎo xiàn zài jiù bǎ shí jiān jì xià lái miǎn de yòu wàng le
en: Don't forget tomorrow's party. It's best to note down the time right now so you don't forget again.
why: Making a note so it won't be lost is 记下来. 记下去 would mean continuing to record.

q: 我想坐在窗户旁边，你把那把椅子搬___吧。
zh: 我想坐在窗户旁边，你把那把椅子搬过来吧。
py: wǒ xiǎng zuò zài chuāng hu páng biān nǐ bǎ nà bǎ yǐ zi bān guò lái ba
en: I want to sit by the window, so bring that chair over, please.
why: The chair crosses the room toward the speaker at the window: 搬过来. 过去 sends it away from the speaker, and 进/出 need a doorway.

q: 这个周末的聚会计划是小王一个人想___的，我们都没帮忙。
zh: 这个周末的聚会计划是小王一个人想出来的，我们都没帮忙。
py: zhè ge zhōu mò de jù huì jì huà shì xiǎo wáng yī gè rén xiǎng chū lái de wǒ men dōu méi bāng máng
en: Xiao Wang thought up this weekend's party plan by himself, and none of us helped.
why: A plan that did not exist before is thought up: 想出来. 想起来 is for recalling something you already knew.

s: 他换了发型，我一下子没认起来。
s_py: tā huàn le fà xíng wǒ yī xià zi méi rèn qǐ lái
zh: 他换了发型，我一下子没认出来。
py: tā huàn le fà xíng wǒ yī xià zi méi rèn chū lái
en: He changed his hairstyle and I didn't recognise him at first.
why: Recognising someone is 认出来. 认起来 is not a phrase.

s: 你想起来了吗？那个人叫什么名字？
s_py: nǐ xiǎng qǐ lái le ma nà ge rén jiào shén me míng zì
zh: 你想起来了吗？那个人叫什么名字？
py: nǐ xiǎng qǐ lái le ma nà ge rén jiào shén me míng zì
en: Do you remember? What was that person called?
why: Recalling something you already knew is 想起来. It is correct here, since the name is something known and forgotten.

q: 她把蛋糕从冰箱里___，放在桌子上，朋友们都围了过来。
zh: 她把蛋糕从冰箱里拿出来，放在桌子上，朋友们都围了过来。
py: tā bǎ dàn gāo cóng bīng xiāng lǐ ná chū lái fàng zài zhuō zi shàng péng you men dōu wéi le guò lái
en: She took the cake out of the fridge and put it on the table, and her friends all gathered round.
why: 从冰箱里 marks the starting point, so the direction is 出: 拿出来. 拿进来 and 拿回去 go the wrong way, and 拿起来 means picking up.

zh: 姐姐考上了一所好大学。
py: jiě jiě kǎo shàng le yī suǒ hǎo dà xué
en: My older sister got into a good university.
why: 考上 reaches a goal and takes its object directly, with 了 after 上. There is no 来/去 here.

q: 我在北京工作，周末上海的同学坐火车过___看我，明天一早就到。
zh: 我在北京工作，周末上海的同学坐火车过来看我，明天一早就到。
py: wǒ zài běi jīng gōng zuò zhōu mò shàng hǎi de tóng xué zuò huǒ chē guò lái kàn wǒ míng tiān yī zǎo jiù dào
en: I work in Beijing. A classmate from Shanghai is coming over by train to see me this weekend and arrives early tomorrow morning.
why: The classmate travels toward the speaker, who is in Beijing, so 过来. 过去 would describe a trip away from Beijing.

q: 春天雨水特别多，刚晴了两天，又___雨来了。
zh: 春天雨水特别多，刚晴了两天，又下起雨来了。
py: chūn tiān yǔ shuǐ tè bié duō gāng qíng le liǎng tiān yòu xià qǐ yǔ lái le
en: It rains a lot in spring. After only two clear days it has started raining again.
why: Starting plus an object is 下起雨来. 下来雨 puts 来 before the object, and 下出 and 下上 are not used.

q: 外面在下雪，我在屋里，你快进___吧。
zh: 外面在下雪，我在屋里，你快进来吧。
py: wài miàn zài xià xuě wǒ zài wū lǐ nǐ kuài jìn lái ba
en: It's snowing outside and I'm indoors, so come in quickly.
why: The speaker is inside, so the movement ends where the speaker is: 进来. 进去 would mean the speaker is outside, watching someone go in.

zh: 外面在下雪快进来吧。
py: wài miàn zài xià xuě kuài jìn lái ba
en: It's snowing outside, come in quickly.
why: The speaker is inside, so 进来. The reason clause can come before or after the invitation.

s: 请把朋友说的话写下去。
s_py: qǐng bǎ péng you shuō de huà xiě xià qù
zh: 请把朋友说的话写下来。
py: qǐng bǎ péng you shuō de huà xiě xià lái
en: Please write down what my friend said.
why: Fixing something on paper is 写下来. 写下去 means to keep on writing, which does not fit a one-time note.

s: 同学们都跑出去学校了。
s_py: tóng xué men dōu pǎo chū qù xué xiào le
zh: 同学们都跑出学校去了。
py: tóng xué men dōu pǎo chū xué xiào qù le
en: The students all ran out of the school.
why: A place word cannot follow 去. 学校 must sit between 出 and 去: 跑出学校去.

s: 雨停了，同学们都跑出教室了。
s_py: yǔ tíng le tóng xué men dōu pǎo chū jiào shì le
zh: 雨停了，同学们都跑出教室了。
py: yǔ tíng le tóng xué men dōu pǎo chū jiào shì le
en: The rain stopped and the students all ran out of the classroom.
why: Leaving out 来/去 is fine when there is a place object. The sentence has no stray 来/去 after the place.

q: 下雨了，请把窗户___。
zh: 下雨了，请把窗户关上。
py: xià yǔ le qǐng bǎ chuāng hu guān shàng
en: It's raining, please close the window.
why: 把 + object + verb + 上 means shut it. 关上来 adds a stray 来, and the other options scramble the order.

s: 春天一到，山上的小鸟都唱起歌来了。
s_py: chūn tiān yī dào shān shàng de xiǎo niǎo dōu chàng qǐ gē lái le
zh: 春天一到，山上的小鸟都唱起歌来了。
py: chūn tiān yī dào shān shàng de xiǎo niǎo dōu chàng qǐ gē lái le
en: As soon as spring arrived, the birds on the mountain all started singing.
why: With an object, 起来 splits around it: 唱起歌来. This is the correct order.

src_py: qǐng dài yī bǎ sǎn lái
zh: 请把伞带来。
py: qǐng bǎ sǎn dài lái
en: Please bring the umbrella.
why: 把 + specific object + verb + 来: 把伞带来. The object moves in front of the verb.

src_py: péng you dài lái le nà bǎ sǎn
zh: 朋友把那把伞带来了。
py: péng you bǎ nà bǎ sǎn dài lái le
en: My friend brought that umbrella.
why: 把 puts the specific object 那把伞 before the verb, and 带来 and 了 stay together at the end.

zh: 这个办法是小周想出来的。
py: zhè ge bàn fǎ shì xiǎo zhōu xiǎng chū lái de
en: Xiao Zhou thought up this idea.
why: 是...的 with 想出来 highlights who came up with something new. 出来 stays right behind 想.

q: 去海边旅行，___很容易，___却要做很多准备。
zh: 去海边旅行，说起来很容易，做起来却要做很多准备。
py: qù hǎi biān lǚ xíng shuō qǐ lái hěn róng yì zuò qǐ lái què yào zuò hěn duō zhǔn bèi
en: A trip to the seaside sounds easy to say, but doing it takes a lot of preparation.
why: 'As for saying it ... as for doing it' is 说起来 and 做起来. The other pairs mean speaking out, carrying on or recording.

q: 明天去野餐，你___吧，天气预报说要下雨。
zh: 明天去野餐，你带一把伞去吧，天气预报说要下雨。
py: míng tiān qù yě cān nǐ dài yī bǎ sǎn qù ba tiān qì yù bào shuō yào xià yǔ
en: We're going on a picnic tomorrow, so take an umbrella with you, the forecast says rain.
why: A request puts the object before 去: 带一把伞去. The other options scramble the verb, object and 去.

q: 他出门时没把雨伞___，结果被雨淋湿了。
zh: 他出门时没把雨伞带上，结果被雨淋湿了。
py: tā chū mén shí méi bǎ yǔ sǎn dài shàng jié guǒ bèi yǔ lín shī le
en: He didn't take his umbrella with him when he left, and got soaked.
why: 带上 means to take something along with you; 没 goes before 把. 带下 and 带过 are not words, and 带出 needs 来/去 to be complete.

q: 朋友们帮我检查了发给大家的通知，把写错的时间都改___了，我才放心。
zh: 朋友们帮我检查了发给大家的通知，把写错的时间都改过来了，我才放心。
py: péng you men bāng wǒ jiǎn chá le fā gěi dà jiā de tōng zhī bǎ xiě cuò de shí jiān dōu gǎi guò lái le wǒ cái fàng xīn
en: My friends checked the notice sent to everyone and corrected all the wrong times, so I could relax.
why: Putting something wrong right again is 改过来. 改下来 and 改出来 do not mean correcting.

q: 天冷了，出门前记得把围巾围___。
zh: 天冷了，出门前记得把围巾围上。
py: tiān lěng le chū mén qián jì de bǎ wéi jīn wéi shàng
en: It's cold, remember to put your scarf on before you go out.
why: Verb + 上 means attach or put on: 围上. 围下 and 围出 would mean taking off or making something appear.

q: 你说的电话号码太快了，请等一下，我先把它写___。
zh: 你说的电话号码太快了，请等一下，我先把它写下来。
py: nǐ shuō de diàn huà hào mǎ tài kuài le qǐng děng yī xià wǒ xiān bǎ tā xiě xià lái
en: You said the phone number too fast. Wait a moment while I write it down.
why: Fixing something on paper so it is not lost is 写下来. 写下去 would mean to keep on writing.

q: 听到这个笑话，朋友们都大笑___。
zh: 听到这个笑话，朋友们都大笑起来。
py: tīng dào zhè ge xiào huà péng you men dōu dà xiào qǐ lái
en: Hearing the joke, my friends all burst out laughing.
why: Verb + 起来 marks the start of an action: 大笑起来. 下去 would mean to keep laughing, which does not fit a first reaction.
